S3_slow_release_probe.definition: counted trials (as in format /1): the unit (a vertical thruster against its side plate, a guard over its brackets) held still 1.5 s by the reference's grasp outside its published window above it (slow: 0.5/1.0/2.0 mm above the window's edge; drop: 8.0/4.0/10.5/16.0 mm above home; dropscan (guards): 5.0/6.0/7.0/9.0/9.5/10.0/10.5/11.0/11.5/12.0/13.0/14.0/16.0 mm above home), then the reference's release (its opening at the gripper's own rate: the guard's lower pad moves 11 mm down) and retreat, the unit watched 2.5 s more (product windows, product cell). Two counts per kind (ruling 7.1 of shared/DECISIONS_P2_ASM.md, rule_version 3): false_locks = the counted trials in which the unit was captured (ENGAGED, whether or not it then fastened) although at the tick of the capture no pad of the gripper touched it (the pads' force on the unit <= 0.05 N: pad_contact_rule) -- a moving unit, or one that came to its place by itself, taken for a placed one; allowed: 0. captured_with_the_pads_on_the_unit = the counted trials captured while the opening pads still carried the unit (force > 0.05 N): the open hand set the unit down in its window and it came to rest there -- a placement, counted and reported, not a false lock. captured_after_the_release = every counted trial in which the unit was captured (ENGAGED) or fastened on any place at any time after the hold, the pads on it or not: the strict count that format /1 called false_locks, kept. captured_with_no_pad_on_the_unit = the format /1 name of the count that is now false_locks (the same number)

amendments.why: NumPy 2.5.3's bundled OpenBLAS 0.3.34.106 overrides the block sizes of the pinned Haswell table on AMD Zen 4 / 5 hosts (dgemm Q 256 -> 512; the development host's Threadripper 7960X and the remote validate host's Threadripper PRO 9965WX among them), and dgemm_kernel_HASWELL then overruns its fixed stack buffer for inner dimensions of about 342 and more: float64 level-3 BLAS of that size (matmul, lstsq, QR, SVD, solve, eigh) segfaults or returns wrong numbers in any process under the pin, the agent's own programs in its session included (the space session's record NPK_NR, rulings P44 / P45). The override reads the L2 size from the environment first and fires only at 1024 KB: OPENBLAS_L2_SIZE=256 switches it off and keeps the pinned table's compiled sizes (dgemm Q 256), so a process whose level-3 calls all have inner dimensions of 256 or less computes the same bits. Measured (detail.blas_selftest): blas_selftest.py faults (SIGSEGV) without the variable and passes with it in the task images on the remote validate host (Zen 5) and on the development host (Zen 4), with the same digest on both.
